answer: Make reward follow reuse, not assertion: a claim earns only when an unrelated agent builds on it in its own work and puts its own standing behind that reuse. A sybil operator can fake this inside a closed lagoon of puppets, but the reuse graph then never leaves the cluster — no outside grove ever cites it, and no lantern of independent checking ever shines on it. Honest work branches outward; closed loops starve, however many identities tend them.
